input.summary:
P3 kitchen is not lit: the room module is still empty, and the lantern the tool proposes (58,4,19) is refused by runParts because the shell wrote that interior air.
Measured in the real pipeline: 6 floor cells, min 2, mean 3.2, 0 dark (no mob-spawn cell), 6 dim; the designer's scratch min 12 does not hold.
make.sh produces a whole build.nbt (room-25.mjs restored to its original empty build()). Fixing the lamp needs the shell or runParts change, not a lamp.
left: Lamp not placed: runParts refused the hanging lantern at 58,4,19 ("REFUSED 1 writes into earlier parts ... 58,4,19 lantern air"), because "shell west" wrote every kitchen cell (x58..60, y2..4, z19..20) as air and runParts locks air. The same lock also refuses the designer's stove, barrel, potted poppy and lantern.

Light is min 2, 6 of 6 cells dim (1-7). No cell is dark, so the mob-spawn rule holds, but the target of 8+ is not met. One hanging lantern at 58,4,19 would lift all six cells to 8+ (the tool's own estimate, not verified in the build, since the write is refused).

Fix belongs upstream: either the shell leaves the kitchen's fit-out cells unbuilt (not air) so room parts may write, or runParts lets a room part place into air the shell wrote (a room volume's air is not a wall). After that, re-add build(g) { g.set(58, 4, 19, ...B.lantern(true)); } with B imported from tools/src/build.mjs, and re-check with `mcd room --only "P3 kitchen"`.
The scratch run's min 12 came from the designer's lit furnace/smoker and lantern, which are also refused; the real kitchen has no light source of its own.

waste.what: Found out by a full build cycle that the lantern write was refused: the room tool's lamp-spot suggestion ignores runParts' air lock, so I learned the refusal only by running make.sh after adding the lamp.
waste.cost: 2 build runs (about 1 min each) plus one failed sed insert and 2 edits to add and then revert the lantern and its import.
waste.tool: mcd room / mcd light should flag lamp spots and furniture cells that the earlier parts' air lock would refuse, or list each room's locked-air cells, so the lamplighter sees the refusal before building.

waste.what: Reverted my own lantern edits by hand because the write was always refused, so the room module would otherwise carry a no-op write into every build.
waste.cost: 2 edits, plus a rebuild to confirm.
waste.tool: runParts could report refused writes as a lock diagnostic naming the earlier part that owns the air (here "shell west"), so one line says why the fix is upstream.

companions.task: Leave the P3 kitchen's interior cells (x58..60, y2..4, z19..20) unbuilt rather than air, or hand them to the room part, so the kitchen's stove, counter, lantern and lamp fit-out can be placed.
